factions.name: China
additionalRules: Active Defense - Units that start on the table start may start in Ambush. Before the start of the game, pull an Order Dice from the bag and issue an Ambush Order to the units starting this way. Ambush Orders may trigger after a unit has been shot as well as during an enemy unit's move. Must target the unit that initiated the trigger window. (Either shot at the unit with Ambush, was moving, or completed a movement.
A2/AD - Enemy Units cannot Outflank and cannot be issued a Run Order onto the Board. May only move onto the board with an Advance Order.

Party Primacy - Company Commanders provide a +5 Morale Bonus, Platoon Commanders a +3 Morale Bonus, and Command Vehicles a +2 Morale Bonus. If your Company Commander is defeated, all your units suffer a -1 to their Order Tests. If one your Platoon Commanders is defeated, all units in the platoon are -1 to their Order Tests unless they are within 12in of a Company Commander or within 6in of a Platoon Commander or Command Vehicle.
Manufacturing Base - Gain Access to additional Drones per teams with drone operations.
Theater Commands - Gain Access to Element Types.

factions.name: France
additionalRules: Culture of Expeditionary Warfare - All HQ and Platoon Leaders must be taken as Veterans, including Vehicles being given the Command Rule or having the Command Rule when taken as your Armored Platoon Commander.
French Foreign Legion - Any unit in this army can be fielded as French Foreign Legion, gaining the 'Marche ou Crève' Special Rule.
Honneur et Patrie: - French Army Infantry Units get a +1 to their Morale Rating when taking a Morale Test if any other French Army Infantry Unit is is within 8in.

factions.name: Germany
additionalRules: Operationsplan Deutschland - Does not suffer the penalty to Order Tests when a unit in Reserve or Outflanking is attempting to move on to the table. Vehicles ignore the first pin when taking Order or Morale Tests. (Example: If a Vehicle has 3 Pins, Order Test as if it has 2 Pins. You still have to take a test though if you have Pin.)

Multi-Domain Operations - Regular and Veteran Infantry and Artillery Units do not suffer the -1 to their Morale when losing their Squad Leader/NCO. Vehicles with the Command Vehicle rule may Snap-To and apply their Morale Bonus to Infantry and Artillery Units.
No Safe Havens - Spotters/Observers may spot for more than one Indirect Weapon in turn. When firing Indirect, ranging in starts at +5 instead of +6 if you are using a Forward Artillery Observer.
Teilung Deutschlands - XXX

factions.name: Japan
additionalRules: Self Defense Force - When a Unit starts the game on the table, it may be given an Ambush Order. Enemy infiltrators cannot be placed within 18in of your units and cannot be Hidden, unless the opposing army is also Japan, in which case this is ignored.
Renunciation of War (Article 9) - Inexperienced Units automatically have the Green Rule.
Rapid Response - Units that start in Reserve ignore the -1 to their order test when moving on the board.

factions.name: Russia
additionalRules: In Defense of the Motherland - At the start of the turn, each Regular or Veteran Russian unit can remove 1 Pin if they roll a 4+ on a D6. If no pins remain, still take an order test.

Non-Linear Battle - Russian units can be ordered on to the table with an Advance or Run starting on Turn 1. When Outflanking, they must be given a Down order on Turn 1. Outflanking units on turn 2 or 3 may enter on the your side of the table or on the declared side, up to your opponents deployment area.
Stockpiled Artillery Ammunition - Artillery Units and Artillery Bombardments are +1 to Hit and -1 to their Pen Value.
VDV: Russian Veteran Infantry Units may be given Air Assault for +2 Point Per Model.

factions.name: Sweden
additionalRules: Preparedness in Peactime - At the start of the game, Regular or Veteran units that start on the table may be given an Ambush Order. Take an order from the bag and place it next to the unit in Ambush

Artic Operations - Infantry and unmounted Artillery Units may take Skis and Winter Equipment for free. Swedish vehicles ignore the Snow Rules. Swedish units moving across Ice have a +1 to the first roll on the Thin Ice Table.
Total Defense - Enemy units cannot move on to the board prior to the first wave. If an Enemy units starts on the board, they cannot perform a move before the first turn.

Mission Command - After each unit is issued an order via a Snap-To, each time you select the next order to resolve after the Company or Platoon Commander, you may change the order originally given via Snap-To. At the end of a round, in addition to attempting to Fire, a unit with an Ambush may test to Run or Advance as well in the same way it would attempt to resolve to Fire.

factions.name: United States of America
additionalRules: Sphere of Infulence - US Assets all around the world allow for quick response to combat breaking out. Air Observers can call in a strike twice per game.

Joint Command - US Military is versed in working together to accomplish the mission, branches frequently imbedded with each other. Unitzs can apply USMC, US Army, US Navy, or US Air Force Rules to select squads.
